record.question: Whoever gives or fabricates false evidence intending thereby to cause, or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby cause, any person to be convicted of an offence which by the law for the time being in force in India is not capital, but punishable with ________.
options: imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term of seven years or upwards
imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term of six years or upwards
imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term of five years or upwards
imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term of eight years or upwards
